pages.text: The Wireless Transmitter is a key component for wireless networking in Refined Storage. It allows you to connect wireless devices to your network from a distance.

To use the Wireless Transmitter:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Insert a Network Card to configure the wireless network$(li)Use wireless devices within the configured range
The range of the Wireless Transmitter can be increased by adding Range Upgrades. Each upgrade increases the range by 8 blocks, up to a maximum of 32 blocks with 3 upgrades.
